'''Lem Karner''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He assisted a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in finding the Barrager and installing the Power Monitor in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].
